title: The roton energy gap: Feynman's estimates against the value the data required
description: Bar chart. The minimum energy of a roton in liquid helium, in kelvin. Feynman's 1954 estimate from his trial wave function, 19.1 K; the Feynman and Cohen 1956 estimate from an improved wave function, 11.5 K; the value required by thermodynamic data, as quoted by Feynman and Cohen, 9.6 K. Data: R. P. Feynman and M. Cohen, Energy Spectrum of the Excitations in Liquid Helium, Physical Review 102 (1956), abstract.
heading: ROTON ENERGY GAP Δ · KELVIN
